en: Black‑and‑white postcard with an illustrated thistle border featuring two inset photographs of old stone structures. The left image, labeled "TOR.", shows a person walking through a massive medieval stone gate with several concentric arches, part of a fortification wall. The right image, labeled "GIEBEL.", shows the gable end of a ruined stone building with narrow arched windows, behind a long stone wall and beside what appears to be a track or path. The overall layout and typography suggest an early 20th‑century European postcard.
